name: kb_prepare_impact_review
description: Prepare complete content-bound impact-review authoring inputs from the current staged snapshot or explicitly selected immutable Git commits. Use it when kb_check reports that changed files need an impact review; it does not plan KB changes. Returns strict reviewer schemas and an unauthored template; it does not decide, approve, sign, stage, or prove the review.

scope.description: What to review: {"kind":"staged"} for the staged snapshot, or {"kind":"diff","baseCommit":"<sha>","headCommit":"<sha>"} with full commit hashes.
